intro: The State of Lakeshire is an urgent written report penned by Magistrate Solomon detailing the desperate military crisis gripping the town of Lakeshire. Intended directly for General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind, the document pleads for the capital to deploy royal army reinforcements before the Redridge settlement falls.

p: Penned by Magistrate Solomon amid relentless attacks on Redridge, 'The State of Lakeshire' outlines the dire circumstances threatening the township. Besieged by hostile Blackrock orcs and gnolls, Lakeshire lacks the local manpower to hold its borders indefinitely. Entrusted to trusted couriers traveling the road west to Elwynn Forest, this dispatch carries Solomon's formal request for the Stormwind Army to intervene and preserve the eastern reach of the kingdom.

Upon delivery to General Marcus Jonathan at Stormwind's gates, the general acknowledges Solomon's noble standing and the gravity of the report. However, Jonathan cannot mobilize the army unilaterally. Military deployments require the explicit consent of the crown, forcing Lakeshire's urgent plea to wait upon high-level council with the young King and the regent Bolvar Fordragon.
